draw_hint: Hold trigger or pinch and trace a closed outline on a surface.
move_hint: Hold grip to move within this surface.
delete_hint: Hold B / Y for two seconds to delete.
object_hint: Click thumbstick to open. Move left or right; trigger to confirm.
three_star: Optimal count and time; no collisions
sandbox_hint: Draw and launch freely. No win or loss.
v_welcome: Welcome to the Gravity Laboratory. Scan your surroundings to begin.
v_scan: Look around slowly to identify the floor, tables, and walls.
v_ready: Scan complete. Draw a portal on a detected surface.
v_draw: Hold the trigger or pinch, and trace a closed outline.
v_select: Click the thumbstick to choose a payload.
v_launch: Press the trigger to place the payload at the first portal.
v_loop: Loop established. The payload is circulating steadily.
v_fail: Collision detected. Experiment stopped. Reset the mission when ready.
v_move: Hold the grip button to move the portal within its current surface.
v_delete: Point at a portal and hold B or Y for two seconds to delete it.
v_lost: Surface tracking lost. Scan your surroundings again.
panel_drag: Hold grip to move. Pinch the title area to drag by hand.
scan_hint: Look around slowly and wait for detected real surfaces.
scan_real_only: Portals can only be drawn on detected real surfaces.
running: Experiment running: observe the trajectory and return.
launch_needs_fit: Meet the mission portal count and make every aperture large enough for the payload.
portal_ready: Portal anchored. Draw another or select a payload.
portal_overlap: Portals cannot overlap an existing aperture.
outside_surface: The outline leaves the detected surface. Draw inside its boundary.
invalid_shape: Draw a large closed outline without crossing the stroke.
asset_error: Asset loading failed. Restart the app and check its log.
scan_unavailable: Room scanning is unavailable. Check tracking and spatial permissions.
fit_hint: Every portal must fit the entire payload. Small apertures block launch.
reset_hint: The payload collided and fell. Reset the mission to plan again.
tutorial_practice: Practice on a real surface beside this panel, then continue.
sandbox_collision: Contact detected. Once the payload lands and portals close, keep creating.
